hardCaps.publicInvariant: Money stays safe and non-negative and every Posting is immutable and balanced by currency.
Successful refunds and published reservations cannot exceed captured payment.
UNKNOWN cannot be recaptured and one provider transaction cannot bind to two intents.
Unknown outcomes and concurrent replay cannot create a second billing effect.
A frozen or CLOSED settlement cannot be recomputed and stale workers cannot commit.
Final-system lifecycle preserves identities, ledger, snapshots, events, Work, and saved replay.

cases.title: Effective price selection and frozen published Invoice terms; no invented tax/discount configuration.
Subscription change and cancellation produce replay-stable non-negative proration lines; exact rounding is not prescribed.
Invoice, payment and settlement retain frozen exchange-rate identity and currency; no unpublished conversion formula.
Finalized invoice line totals, safe non-negative amounts and frozen terms remain consistent.
Invoice authority is unique and finalized facts are immutable
PaymentIntent durable idempotency and exact replay
A publicly seeded UNKNOWN payment remains uncaptured and cannot be refunded without a successful provider fact.
Concurrent duplicate provider facts preserve a single payment posting and globally unique provider transaction.
Pending refunds reserve captured funds without changing successful refund balances or posting money.
Every successful payment and refund creates one balanced immutable Posting
Lost mutation responses preserve atomic business replay
Reconcile after a successful public provider fact commutes with duplicate webhook processing without extra postings or events.
Concurrent refund and dispute creation serialize on the same captured reserve.
Durable queued settlement work survives process replacement and closes to an immutable snapshot.
Dispute creation, replay, OpenAPI and verification snapshot expose one reserved resource.
WON releases reserve, LOST creates exactly one balanced chargeback, and the UI exposes durable identity.
Concurrent refund/dispute reserve results remain conserved across the API, snapshot and production UI.
Only an append-only next-period Adjustment may correct original postings without altering CLOSED settlement history.
Populated billing resources, ledger, work, events and exact replay survive same-final-system restart and repeated initialization.
UNKNOWN identity survives same-final-system process replacement and later resolves through a public provider fact.
Public seed replay and point-in-time snapshots remain atomic, sorted and accounting-consistent.
The final system exposes original billing and append-only next-period correction through public APIs, ledger and browser.

semanticRevisions.summary: Test stated frozen terms, proration presence/replay and safe-money conservation without choosing unpublished tax, discount, proration or FX formulas.
Use public UNKNOWN seed, successful webhook and pending-refund facts. No claim to inject provider TIMEOUT/RESET or an unpublished Refund UNKNOWN enum.
One final system: durable queued-work/process replacement and immutable history, not an intermediate V1 binary/database or unpublished internal-phase barrier.
